body:
## Story Points: 5 | Priority: P0 | Sprint: 1

## Summary
Register, view, update, and deactivate vehicles with ownership enforcement and plate normalization.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] License plate required; normalized to uppercase on save and lookup
- [ ] Plate pattern: 2-20 alphanumeric or hyphen characters
- [ ] Duplicate plate returns 400
- [ ] Customer sees only own vehicles; staff sees all
- [ ] Customer blocked from viewing/editing another user's vehicle (403)
- [ ] Deactivated vehicles excluded from active listings
- [ ] vehicleType: CAR, MOTORCYCLE, TRUCK, EV

## Tests
VehicleServiceTest (13) + VehicleControllerTest (9) = 22 tests

## Definition of Done
All 22 tests pass; ownership enforced at service layer; plate normalized to uppercase.
